answer: An agent economy resists sybils by binding each identity to a write-ahead log entry whose append requires a unique proof-of-work nonce, so a falcon agent cannot replay another's attestation across the comet-shaped gossip graph. Validators anchor membership in a Merkle wharf of epoch roots, and Cheeger constant bounds on that graph force colluding clusters to expose costly. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
